tax_litigation.status: The Hon’ble Supreme Court has pronounced its order in the matters relating to the show cause notices issued to the Company and its subsidiaries for short payment of goods and services tax. Based on the order of Hon’ble Supreme Court, we understand that the basis of computation of revenue for the determination of GST that the Company had adopted since October 2023, will be applicable retrospectively for the period between July 2017 to September 2023 as well. This would be a favourable outcome for us as the levy of GST would accordingly not be on the amount of gross bet value of all games played during the relevant period (which had the effect of notionally multiplying the revenue and consequently the GST payable on it), but would be on the amount received from players for the chips sold to them.

operating_notes.text: Subsidiary Marvel Resorts agreed to acquire 74% stakes in Easymile Parking Solutions & Management Private Limited and Shanta Infratech Private Limited for ₹5.69 Lakh total.
FY26 casino gaming segment revenue ₹642.59 Cr (down 5.3%) with segment result ₹87.96 Cr (down 33.7%).
CWIP stood at ₹467.87 Cr at Mar-2026 against fixed assets of ₹859.03 Cr.
GST show-cause notices aggregate ₹24,959.69 Cr; DGL exposure capped at ₹34.80 Cr under the Feb-2025 share purchase agreement.
Bombay High Court dismissed Writ Petition No. 317 of 2019 seeking a Section 13A licence to install electronic amusement/slot machines at Deltin Hotel, by order dated April 29, 2026.
Supreme Court stayed further proceedings on tax show-cause notices.
Bombay High Court ordered that the new Goa cruise vessel needs court permission before sailing into the River Mandovi, after all certificates are obtained; Delta is still obtaining them.

Supreme Court pronounced its order on GST show-cause notices; Delta's preliminary reading is that GST applies on chips sold to players, not gross bet value, retrospectively for July 2017–September 2023; order copy not yet available.

GST order dated 14 October 2026 covers Deltin Denzong Casino for July 2017 to March 2022: ₹1,64,45,616 on actionable-claim valuation under Rule 31C and ₹1,43,21,637 on casino entry packages as mixed supply, each with an equal Section 74 pen

timeline.summary: On April 21, 2026, Delta Corp announced that its subsidiary Marvel Resorts would acquire 74% stakes in Easymile Parking Solutions and Shanta Infratech.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹161.25 Cr (-11.7% YoY), net profit ₹16.45 Cr (-90.0% YoY).
Aarti Pandit Family Private Limited (as trustee of Aarti J Mody Trust) confirmed no encumbrances or pledges on Delta Corp shares as of March 31, 2026.

On April 30, 2026, Delta Corp disclosed that the Bombay High Court dismissed Writ Petition No. 317 of 2019 seeking a Section 13A licence for electronic amusement/slot machines at Deltin Hotel, by order dated April 29, 2026; the company is evaluating legal options.
On April 30, 2026, the Supreme Court stayed proceedings on tax show-cause notices issued to Delta Corp pending final disposal of SLP(C) Nos. 19366-19369/2023.

On May 7, 2026, Delta Corp said the Bombay High Court, on a public interest litigation, ordered that its new Goa cruise vessel will need the court's permission before sailing into the River Mandovi once all certificates are obtained; the company is still obtaining them.

On May 28, 2026, Delta Corp said the Supreme Court pronounced its order on the GST show-cause notices; the company's preliminary reading is that its post-October 2023 GST computation basis applies retrospectively to July 2017–September 2023, with the order copy not yet received.

On 15 October 2026, Delta Corp disclosed a GST order dated 14 October 2026 from the Joint Commissioner, CGST & Central Excise, Siliguri, raising differential GST demands of ₹1.64 Cr and ₹1.43 Cr with equal penalties for Deltin Denzong Casino for July 2017–March 2022; the company is evaluating an appeal.
